mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Imagine living in a world where every second seems to demand your productivity, and even a glance is up for grabs. Sound familiar? These days, it feels like notifications, social media, and endless digital distractions are shaping not just how we spend our time, but even how we see ourselves—and what we think we're worth. Now, what if I told you that simply doing nothing could be a bold, radical act? That’s the invitation at the heart of Jenny Odell’s inspiring book, How to Do Nothing: Resisting the Attention Economy. Odell encourages us to step back from the constant clamor for our attention, and rethink what it really means to be present. Here, “doing nothing” isn’t just about idleness—it’s a conscious, powerful stand against a world that profits from keeping us distracted and divided. Together, we’ll explore how tuning out the noise can actually open us up to a quieter, richer way of living—one that prizes careful observation, real connections with the world around us, and genuine engagement with our communities. As we journey through stories of art, nature, and belonging, you’ll see how reclaiming your attention can spark creativity, deepen empathy, and help us all move toward a more intentional—and more meaningful—life. Let’s dive in together, and discover what happens when we choose to do nothing… and everything that possibility unlocks.
